terminology.diagnosisRule: совместимая клиника плюс повышенный total T4 подтверждают явный гипертиреоз; масса или пальпируемый узел отдельно недостаточны
terminology.equivocalRule: high-normal/normal T4 не всегда исключает раннюю болезнь, но free T4/TSH не читаются отдельно от total T4 и nonthyroidal illness
terminology.renalRule: CKD не является причиной не лечить; thyroid control может раскрыть renal dysfunction и требует совместного baseline/followup
terminology.cardiacRule: tachycardia, murmur or gallop требуют оценки, но не равны CHF
terminology.protocolRule: код не задаёт препарат, дозу, target T4, диетический состав, radioiodine или surgery technique

commonHistoryQuestions.text: Как быстро и насколько изменилась масса и мышцы?
Аппетит повышен, нормален, снижен или изменчив?
Стала ли кошка громче или раздражительнее?
Есть ли рвота или диарея и как часто?
Есть ли одышка, слабость, коллапс или обморок?
Есть ли датированные T4, creatinine, SDMA, urine и BP?
Есть ли thyroid treatment или iodine-restricted diet и как соблюдается?
Ест ли кошка что-либо кроме назначенного рациона?
Какой контроль, транспорт, бюджет и домашний уход выполнимы?

variants.title: Явный классический гипертиреоз кошки
variants.diagnosticTruth: Клинически совместимая кошка с повышенным total T4 имеет overt hyperthyroidism; до выбора маршрута фиксируются renal, urine, BP, cardiac and weight baselines.

presentations.complaint: Зрелая кошка ест хорошо или больше обычного, но постепенно худеет.

examFindings.finding: Compatible weight/appetite pattern plus high total T4.
Diabetes, GI disease and neoplasia remain if authored findings are not fully explained.

followUp.timing: reviewed treatment route with early T4/renal/BP/weight checkpoint

outcomes.safe: Overt diagnosis and complete baseline precede route selection.
outcomes.unsafe: Weight loss alone or one tablet without baseline ends the case.

ownerCommunication: Explain multiple reviewed options and their monitoring burden.

presentations.complaint: Кошка стала активнее, громче, больше пьёт и мочится и понемногу теряет массу.

examFindings.finding: PU/PD and behavior support hyperthyroidism but are nonspecific.
High total T4 confirms in context; renal/urine baseline separates CKD/diabetes.

outcomes.unsafe: Behavior is treated as bad temperament or a single-cause sign.

ownerCommunication: Explain that irritability can be a symptom and handling should stay low-stress.

presentations.complaint: Senior screening показывает высокий total T4 при лишь небольшой потере массы или тонком сердечном признаке.

historyAnswers.cardiorespiratory_signs: No failure signs; subtle clue only.

examFindings.finding: Clinically subtle high result is repeated/verified when lab/time context creates concern.
Minimal signs do not remove heart, BP or renal assessment.

investigations.result: Authored persistent high or false-positive resolution.

followUp.timing: result verification then full route monitoring

outcomes.safe: Early disease is verified without skipping baseline.
outcomes.unsafe: One unexpected lab triggers irreversible treatment immediately.

ownerCommunication: Explain why subtle disease can still matter and why verification may be appropriate.

variants.title: Сомнительный или скрытый гипертиреоз кошки
variants.diagnosticTruth: Compatible signs with high-normal/normal total T4 require repeat and integrated additional testing; nodule and free T4 alone do not confirm functional hyperthyroidism.

presentations.complaint: Пожилая кошка худеет и тахикардична, но total T4 находится высоко в референсе.

examFindings.finding: Senior cat signs remain compatible because T4 can be normal in a minority and declines with age.
Repeat total T4 plus fT4/TSH context; scintigraphy/referral if conflict persists.

followUp.timing: authored short repeat or specialist result

outcomes.safe: Equivocal status resolves by defined algorithm.
outcomes.unsafe: Normal T4 ends workup or free T4 alone starts treatment.

ownerCommunication: Explain uncertainty and what each next result can change.

presentations.complaint: На шее пальпируется узел, но total T4 нормален и клинические признаки отсутствуют или минимальны.

examFindings.finding: A neck/thyroid nodule raises suspicion but does not prove hormone production.
Repeat T4/weight or specialist localization; mass differential remains.

followUp.timing: fixed T4/weight recheck or specialist localization

outcomes.safe: Nodule stays a finding until function is demonstrated.

presentations.complaint: Больная кошка худеет, но significant nonthyroidal illness может снижать total T4 и путать картину.

examFindings.finding: Meaningful concurrent disease changes hormone interpretation.
fT4 can be abnormal in nonthyroidal illness and is read only with total T4/clinical status.

outcomes.safe: Sick-cat context is treated and thyroid uncertainty revisited.
outcomes.unsafe: fT4 alone is cherry-picked to confirm hyperthyroidism.

ownerCommunication: Explain why illness can change thyroid tests.

variants.title: Гипертиреоз с сопутствующей или маскированной CKD
variants.diagnosticTruth: Hyperthyroidism and CKD can coexist; increased GFR and muscle loss can mask renal dysfunction, so thyroid control uses preserved renal/hydration/urine/BP baselines and early joint rechecks.

presentations.complaint: У кошки уже документирована CKD, а теперь клиника и высокий total T4 подтверждают гипертиреоз.

historyAnswers.prior_t4_renal_records: Stable CKD stage/substages and current high T4 preserved.

examFindings.finding: Both diagnoses are authored and managed jointly.
Hydration, creatinine/SDMA, urine, UPC, BP, weight and T4 are linked before reviewed choice.

outcomes.safe: Both diseases remain visible and monitored.
outcomes.unsafe: CKD blocks all thyroid care or thyroid result erases CKD.

ownerCommunication: Explain joint benefit/risk without promising unchanged renal values.

presentations.complaint: Во время protocol-defined обратимого контроля оцениваются T4, почки, аппетит и давление перед окончательным маршрутом.

historyAnswers.thyroid_treatment_diet_history: Reviewed reversible step documented without dose in content.

examFindings.finding: Joint trend informs route but cannot guarantee definitive post-treatment renal outcome.
Agent stores reviewed treatment-state only; no dose/target inference.

followUp.timing: protocol-defined early response before route decision

outcomes.unsafe: Trial is treated as perfect prediction or code invents target/dose.

ownerCommunication: Explain what the reversible step can and cannot predict.

presentations.complaint: После thyroid control creatinine/SDMA выросли или urine/clinical findings раскрыли renal dysfunction.

examFindings.finding: Hydration, over-suppression, acute factors and stable new renal baseline are checked.
Plan is jointly revised; no reflex cancellation or acceptance without monitoring.

followUp.timing: short joint review until stable thyroid and renal baseline

outcomes.safe: Postcontrol renal change is classified in joint context.
outcomes.unsafe: All therapy is stopped or renal decline is ignored automatically.

variants.title: Кардиоваскулярное, гипертензивное или тяжёлое течение
variants.diagnosticTruth: Cardiac, hypertensive and apathetic/decompensated patterns require separate urgent assessment; heart finding supports a cardiovascular question but does not automatically establish CHF.

presentations.complaint: У гипертиреоидной кошки тахикардия, нерегулярный ритм, шум или галоп; дыхательные признаки authored отдельно.

examFindings.finding: Rate/rhythm/murmur/gallop directs ECG/echo/referral.
Failure requires respiratory/imaging/echo context; dyspnea gets immediate minimal handling.

outcomes.safe: Cardiac disease is classified and later reassessed.
outcomes.unsafe: A murmur is called CHF or dyspnea waits for full hormone workup.

ownerCommunication: Explain which heart changes may evolve after thyroid control and which require their own plan.

presentations.complaint: Кошка внезапно натыкается на предметы; authored retina finding и высокое давление указывают на target-organ damage.

examFindings.finding: Authored retinal hemorrhage/detachment or compatible damage plus high BP.
Urgent reviewed management and ophthalmology/renal/thyroid routes proceed in parallel.

investigations.result: High BP with authored target-organ lesion.

followUp.timing: urgent retina/BP then joint thyroid/renal treatment-state follow-up

outcomes.unsafe: Blindness waits for weeks of BP confirmation or renderer invents retina result.

ownerCommunication: Explain urgent target-organ risk without promising visual recovery.

presentations.complaint: Вместо гиперактивности кошка слаба, не ест, обезвожена или имеет сердечные/GI признаки.

historyAnswers.prior_t4_renal_records: Thyroid/renal timeline available or absent flag.

examFindings.finding: Severe or comorbid hyperthyroid cat may be apathetic rather than hyperactive.
Hydration, perfusion, temperature, renal, BP and cardiac assessment precede definitive choice.

outcomes.safe: Atypical severe pattern is stabilized and correctly linked.
outcomes.unsafe: Low activity falsely excludes hyperthyroidism or definitive choice delays support.

ownerCommunication: Explain that severe hyperthyroidism may present as weakness, not only hyperactivity.
